name: Content Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with teal wool
body: News, events, team, jobs and page copy, written in your house style. If it's missing a fact, it asks.

name: QA Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with mustard yellow wool
body: Tests every change before you see it, so nothing breaks on the live site.

name: Design & Build Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with burnt orange wool
body: New sections and landing pages from your existing design, plus booking widgets, video and forms. Code changes go to Toby first.

name: SEO Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with pink wool
body: Page titles, descriptions and alt text, plus a monthly report on how people find you in Google.

name: Tracking Sheep
alt: A voxel sheep with purple wool
body: Analytics, conversions and cookie consent, set up properly. Every change goes to Toby first.
